'''Trilobites''' are [[extinct]] [[aquatic]] animals from the [[wikipedia:Cambrian|Cambrian]] era, found in [[temperate]] or [[tropical]] oceans or saltwater [[pool]]s. They are not butcherable or fishable, although they have the {{token|COOKABLE_LIVE|creature}} token.

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] trilobites for their ''spines'' and ''lobopods''.

{{D for Dwarf}}
<!-- Reference: ? -->
They indeed cannot distinguish oboes from elbows. Squid men are somehow both irritated and amused by this.
